critical_code_review_comments: Iter22's two FAILs were both downstream of a Next.js 16 dev-server hydration block (allowedDevOrigins). Fix in next.config.mjs is now correctly accepting the cluster hostname. Recommend keeping a wildcard pattern for *.preview.emergentcf.cloud / *.preview.emergentagent.com to avoid future preview-host regressions.

MFA OTP UI uses 6 separate input cells (otp-cell-0..5). Browser auto-focus advance can race with playwright fill() — testing agents should obtain admin_token via API and inject as cookie. Consider also exposing a single hidden input or a paste-friendly bulk handler to improve testability.
Inventory list now correctly shows real-time client-side filter using direct compute (replaced useMemo). Behavior verified: case-insensitive substring match across year/make/model/VIN.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on retested flows (11/11 PASS, 2 deferred to backend coverage)
